page.layout: One column of text, cut off at the left edge in its first lines; marginal notes in the right margin beside the lines "nus Bovius" and "que conficit". Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at foot left, catchword at foot right.

main_text.p: ves, μονογενὲς ὑπάρχον χῇ τῷ Αἰγυ-χώραν, ἐν περιόδοις[?] πεντακοσίων ἐτῶν μενον, δείκνυσι τὴν ἀνάστασιν, ἐν ἐν οις τόποις, ἵνα μὴ ἀγνοηθῇ τὸ μυστή-γινόμενον, ἀλλ' ἐν Φανερᾷ πόλει παρα-μενον, ἵνα φλαφηθῇ τὸ ἀπιστούμενον· ἐν γὰρ ἑαυτῷ ποιῆσαν ἐκ λιβάνε ϲ σμύρ-νῃ λοιπῶν ἀρωμάτων, ϲ ἐν τῇ συμπλη-ες τῶν ἐτῶν εἰς τοσοῦτον εἰσελθὸν, τελευ-Φανερῶς καὶ σπέρεται· εἶτα καὶ τῆς σαρκί-ς σαρκὸς τῶ τελευτήσαντ◎, σκώληξ τις γνᾶται, καὶ ἔτ◎ αὐξηθεὶς εἰς ὄρνεον μορ-ἔταγ. Hæc avis, ut scribit Clemens; & ii complures idem referunt, cum sit una intum & sola, in terram Ægypti in spa- io quingentorum annorum venire solet, at- ne demonstrare resurrectionem; non in lo- cis desertis, ne mysterium id ignoretur, sed in aperta (vel potius clara & nobili) civi- tate consistit, ut contrectetur, quod non creditur. Loculum enim sibi facit e thure, & myrrha, caterisque aromatibus, & com- pletis annis eo devenit: Moritur aperte & putrescit; deinde ex putrefacta carne mortua, vermis quidam generatur, & hic deinceps in avem efformatur. Hæc Cyril- lus; quæ, quia in quinto Constitutionum libro consimilia de Phœnice narrantur, bo-nus Bovius a eo avidissime retulit, inde-a c. 6. que conficit suarum Constitutionum codi-Bov. 8.

page.notes: The left edge of the first lines is cut off, so the opening fragments (ves, ii, intum, io, ne, etc.) are incomplete. Greek readings marked [?] are uncertain; the Greek is partly blurred. The Latin lines are italic from "Hæc avis" to "Hæc Cyril-"; "Hæc Cyril-" and following are roman. Marginal notes are "a c. 6." and "Bov. 8.".
